elements.name: roadmap-subtitle
elements.text: Proposed stages, delivery approach, and decisions to proceed

elements.name: detailed-roadmap
elements.text:
Stage	Timing	Delivery approach	Decision to proceed
0  Prototype	Dec 2026	Review voice, intent, transcription, documents
and the Shield Advisor experience.	Agree refinements
and MVP scope.
1  Readiness*	Jan 2027	Close prototype gaps. Confirm integrations,
measurement, support and handoffs.	Approve production
launch readiness.
1  MVP	Feb 1–28, 2027	Launch initial high-volume intents with
self-service and a CSR handoff.	Approve the first
expansion release.
2  Expand
intents	Mar–Jun 2027
Monthly releases	Release intent groups defined in Q1.
Target top-20 coverage and deflection.	Review performance
before each release.
Phase 2
discovery	Q2 2027
Parallel work	Design routing and callbacks. Define
digital-journey and copilot pilots.*	Agree pilot scope,
owners and measures.
3  Pilots*	Q3 2027	Pilot routing, context/callbacks and
supervisory assistance in selected scopes.	Review value and
service quality.
4  Expansion*	Q4 2027	Extend proven capabilities to eligible
queues, LOBs, journeys and channels.	Confirm continued
value and ownership.

elements.name: roadmap-note
elements.text: *Proposed refinement. Expansion depends on readiness and results. Outbound voice remains future scope.
